metadata.description: Example mods from claude-code-playground. Shared as-is.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: replay-theater-plus
plugins.description: Replay Theater extended: records shell changes as well as tool edits, keeps the last ten turns, and labels each step with the agent that made it.
